evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

observation.interpretation: The leaf did not gain or lose a damage component; it was multiplied by a single factor that is 1.08 to within display rounding.

step_1_identify_factor.ratio_window_from_1dp_rounding: true old B in [94.05, 94.15); true new N in [101.65, 101.75) => admissible factor N/B in [1.07966, 1.08187]
step_1_identify_factor.conclusion: The only sourced constant in this window is a flat 8% damage amplification. 5% (Bloodsong ranged branch) is excluded: B*1.05 in [98.75, 98.86) -> would print 98.8, not 101.7.

step_2_sourced_8_percent_amp.candidate_a: Bloodsong 'Spellblade' -> Expose Weakness: target takes {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources for 4 s. {{rd|melee|ranged}} => 8% for a melee Bloodsong holder.
step_2_sourced_8_percent_amp.candidate_b: Press the Attack keystone: third stack grants 8% increased damage against that champion (data/runes.json effects.damage_amp_ratio = 0.08).
step_2_sourced_8_percent_amp.note: Both are unconditional flat 8% multiplicative amps once active; either explains the observed factor identically. The scenario name pins Bloodsong as the intended source, and a coupled 'roster' fight is exactly where an ally-held Bloodsong Expose Weakness should amplify the main participant's damage.

step_3_placement_is_mathematically_free.quote: docs/math-foundations.md 1.2/5: mitigation operator x -> x*100/(100+R) is *linear in raw damage* for a fixed resistance; 'mitigation commutes with expectation (linear in raw)'.
step_3_placement_is_mathematically_free.consequence: 1.08 * m(R) * raw == m(R) * (1.08 * raw). Recording the 'increased damage taken/dealt' amp on the raw_damage leaf is numerically identical to applying it post-mitigation, so the amp legitimately shows up on this field.

step_4_arithmetic.conclusion: 101.7 is reproducible from the sourced 8% amp for any true pre-amp value in [94.1204, 94.15), which is inside the interval that prints as 94.1. The pair (94.1, 101.7) is therefore an exact 8% amplification at the corpus' 0.1 display precision.

step_5_ruling_out_the_other_named_item.black_cleaver: data/items.json[3071] 'Carve': 'Each stack inflicts 6% armor reduction, up to 30% at 5 stacks' -- percentage ARMOR REDUCTION only. Per docs/math-foundations.md 2.2, reduction/penetration act on R inside m(R) and cannot move a pre-mitigation raw_damage value. Black Cleaver cannot explain this leaf's change; it is scenario context (the coupled shred timeline), not the cause.
step_5_ruling_out_the_other_named_item.no_additive_candidate: No cached Bloodsong/Black Cleaver constant equals the +7.6 absolute delta; the change is multiplicative, not an added component.

independent_value.basis: pre-amp raw (94.1x) x 1.08 sourced damage amplification
independent_value.precision: reproduced to the corpus' 1-decimal display precision

confidence: high on the mechanism (the delta is exactly one sourced 8% multiplicative damage amp), medium-high on the verdict
caveats: The scenario tuple (roster, champions, levels, items, event ordering) is defined in scripts/, which this runbook forbids reading, so the computation is a factor-level reconstruction rather than a full re-simulation of events[40].

If -- contrary to the scenario name -- the Bloodsong holder in this roster is a RANGED champion and Bloodsong is the only 8%-class amp present, the sourced amp would be 5% and the correct leaf would be ~98.8, making both values wrong. That branch is disfavoured: 5% cannot produce either printed value from the other, whereas 8% reproduces the pair exactly, and Press the Attack's 8% carries no melee/ranged split at all.

The direction of the fix (amp newly applied) rather than the reverse (amp double-counted) is inferred from the fact that the pre-change value equals the un-amplified raw exactly; a double-count would instead show the ratio against an already-amped base, which is the same 1.08 but would require the un-amped raw to be ~87.1 and both printed values to include an amp -- unverifiable without src, and less likely given the scenario exists to exercise Bloodsong.
